sentences.text: Macelognathus possessed leaf-shaped, lanceolate teeth that lacked serrations.
Due to a lack of bone evidence, Macelognathus likely did not have a horny covering on its lower jaw.
Macelognathus is considered an example of convergent evolution because it shares similarities with caenagnathid dinosaurs despite not being closely related to them.
Macelognathus was reclassified as a dinosaur by Moodie in 1908 and later identified as a crocodilian relative by Ostrom in 1971.
In 2005, Göhlich and colleagues identified Macelognathus as a basal crocodylomorph known as a sphenosuchian based on new material from Fruita, Colorado.
Researchers suggest Macelognathus might be a junior synonym of Hallopus victor because their specimens cannot be anatomically distinguished except for the larger size of the Macelognathus holotype.
Macelognathus is classified within the family Hallopodidae.
Macelognathus was an extinct genus of sphenosuchian crocodylomorph that lived during the Late Jurassic.
Macelognathus lived in what is now Wyoming, North America.
Macelognathus measured between 1.2 and 1.9 meters in length.
Macelognathus lived from the Kimmeridgian to the Tithonian stages, approximately 154.8 to 143.1 million years ago.
